title: NCT WISH sells out presales for first Gocheok Dome shows - Aju Press

 NCT WISH sells out presales for first Gocheok Dome shows
 By Joonha Yoo 
 Posted : November 4, 2026, 11:18 
 Updated : November 4, 2026, 11:18 
 Official Poster for K-pop boy group NCT Wish's upcoming Gocheok Dome concert. Courtesy of SM Entertainment. 
SEOUL, November 04 (AJP) - K-pop boy group NCT WISH sold out fan-club presales for both dates of its first concerts at Seoul's Gocheok Sky Dome, SM Entertainment said Wednesday.
The six-member group will perform at the stadium on Jan. 15 and 16 as the opening stop of its second concert tour, "INTO THE WISH : Face Our WISH."
Domestic fan-club presales opened Nov. 2, followed by global presales a day later. Tickets allocated for both rounds sold out across the two shows, according to the agency.
General ticket sales are scheduled to open at 8 p.m. Wednesday.
The concerts mark another jump in venue size for NCT WISH, which performed at Seoul's Olympic Handball Gymnasium in March 2025, Inspire Arena in Incheon in October that year and KSPO Dome in Seoul in April 2026.
The group released its fourth EP, "I SPY," on Oct. 12. SM said the album surpassed 1 million copies in sales on its first day, giving NCT WISH its fourth consecutive million-selling release.
The tour will continue across Asian cities including Kaohsiung, Bangkok, Manila, Tokyo, Taipei, Jakarta, Kuala Lumpur and Hong Kong following the Seoul shows.
